tytul: British piccalilli with mustard: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for British-style piccalilli: cauliflower and other vegetables in a mustard sauce thickened with flour or starch.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Cauliflower is a vegetable, and all fresh vegetables except most tomatoes are low-acid foods with a pH above 4.6.
Most mixtures of low-acid and acid foods have a pH above 4.6 unless the recipe contains enough lemon juice, citric acid or vinegar.
In its Pickled Corn Relish, NCHFP allows the relish to be thickened with a flour paste if desired; this is an exception within that recipe and should not be carried over to other preserves.

akapity: NCHFP has a tested recipe for pickled mixed vegetables with cauliflower, white vinegar of 5% acidity and prepared mustard; its ingredient list has no flour or starch.
The whole product needs a minimum, uniform level of acid to prevent the growth of botulism bacteria.
Do not change the proportions of vinegar, vegetables and water and do not use vinegar of unknown acidity; use only recipes with tested proportions.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for British piccalilli thickened with flour or starch from a checked source.
